name: REVERSE FLYS
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your legs slightly bent. Hold a dumbbell in each hand. \n\nLean your upper body forward into a bent over position. Let your arms hang straight down, then lift your arms to your sides until they are parallel to the floor. Return and repeat.

tips.text: Please keep your back straight, and your abs and glutes tight.
Please squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
This exercise strengthens your upper back muscles.
